notes: {"answer":"Call 911 now. A child who is drowsy or not responding well after a seizure needs emergency care. Lay them on their side on a safe surface, put nothing in their mouth, and don't hold them down. Note when it started.","triage":"Call 911 now or go to the ER right away. Don't wait for 811, which is for non-emergencies. Tell the 911 operator it is a seizure with fever. Stay with them. If they turn blue, struggle to breathe, or seize again, tell 911 right away.","sources":["KidsHealth","Cleveland Clinic","Children's Hospital of Philadelphia","Child Neurology Foundation"]}
